description: Document output (print / message records). NAST on every system; S/4 Output Control read on S/4HANA. Re-issue: ECC only, print medium only — never e-mail, fax, EDI or other sending media.

actions.title: Show the output of a document

params.name: doc_category
params.note: PO = purchase order, SO = sales order, DLV = outbound delivery, BIL = billing document

params.name: vbeln
params.note: sales order, delivery or billing document number (doc_category SO / DLV / BIL)

ECC.note: message records of application EF / V1 / V2 / V3 for the document key; no partner names

S4.note: NAST plus Output Control requests (ZCL_MCP_BIZ_SYS_S4) when Output Control is active for the object type; outbound deliveries stay on NAST

actions.title: Print the output of a document again

params.name: vbeln
params.note: sales order, delivery or billing document number

params.name: kschl
params.note: output type to print again; its last message record is repeated on the same device

clarify.ask: Which output type should be printed again? (OUT.DOC.STATUS lists the ones the document has)

ECC.set: copy of the last NAST record of the output type: new ERDAT / ERUHR, VSTAT 0, MANUE X; then WFMC_MESSAGE_SINGLE processes it
ECC.preview: no simulation: preview = last record of the output type, medium must be 1 (print), print program in TNAPR, target device; nothing is created
ECC.note: print only: any other medium (e-mail, fax, EDI, ALE, special function) is refused by the handler

S4.preview: refused: re-issuing output is not offered on S/4HANA (decision 2026-11-10); OUT.DOC.STATUS reads the output

en: The preview does not run the print program: form errors or a missing printer show only at execute.
A spool request is created at execute and cannot be taken back; the print itself depends on the device.
ko: Preview는 인쇄 프로그램을 실행하지 않아서 폼 오류나 프린터 문제는 실행할 때만 드러나요.
실행하면 스풀 요청이 만들어지고 되돌릴 수 없어요. 실제 인쇄는 출력 장치에 달려 있어요.
